The Random Forest model was trained in Python using scikit-learn, then exported as JSON and embedded directly into this HTML file. Every prediction you make runs the real 80-tree voting logic in JavaScript — same algorithm, same accuracy.

How to Use

3 ways to enter symptoms

1
Click the chips — browse and click any symptom from the grid above.
2
Search — type a keyword like "blur" or "pain" to filter chips.
3
Type manually — enter symptom names or numbers: blurred_vision, 3, 14 then click Add.
4
Click Analyze — the Real Random Forest model instantly predicts your disease.
